text: At Kaguya's request, catch and collect the Tsukimi Dangos\nthat grow legs and are moving around!
The dangos you have collected fuse into one giant dango and\nafter swallowing Pelulu, more dangos gather and they become\na Devil Dango monster. Defeat it to save Pelulu!
You have managed to defeat Devil Dango and save Pelulu.\nHead to the mansion to report to Kaguya!
